sources.snippet: This is operationalized via a three-step pipeline, SafePassage, which consists of: (1) an LLM extractor that generates structured entities and their contexts from a document, (2) a string-based global aligner, and (3) a scoring model.

sources.title: SafePassage: High-Fidelity Information Extraction with Black Box LLMs
sources.snippet: Abstract Black box large language models (LLMs) make information extraction (IE) easy to configure, but hard to trust. Unlike traditional information extraction pipelines, the information “extracted” is not guaranteed to be grounded in the docu-ment.
